name: English: Creative Writing
notes: Ten 4-credit courses (40 credit hours). The upper-level writing requirement is fulfilled by completion of the major.
Students must APPLY to the creative writing advisor and receive written approval to pursue this track.

NOT auto-enforced: of the four upper-level courses, two must be in British or American literature BEFORE 1800 and two AFTER 1800. The catalog records no period per course - see the department's pre-/post-1800 list.

Upper-level writing carries NO separate course requirement here: the department states it is 'fulfilled by completion of the major'. (The harvested catalog also contains no W-designated ENGL courses at the 200-300 level, so a wOnly rule could not be satisfied in any case.)

requirementGroups.label: Introductory creative writing (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two of the following: ENGL 121: Creative Writing: Fiction; ENGL 122: Creative Writing: Poetry; ENGL 123: Playwriting; ENGL 125: Speculative Fiction

requirementGroups.label: Advanced creative writing
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following courses: ENGL 275: Advanced Creative Writing: Fiction; ENGL 276: Advanced Creative Writing: Poetry; ENGL 277: Screenwriting; ENGL 281: Creative Nonfiction

requirementGroups.label: Creative writing seminar
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following: ENGL 375: Seminar in Fiction Writing; ENGL 376: Seminar in Poetry Writing

requirementGroups.label: Survey courses (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two Survey Courses. Two of the following courses: ENGL 112: Classical and Scriptural Backgrounds; ENGL 113: British Literature I; ENGL 114: British Literature II; ENGL 115: American Literature; ENGL 116: Intro to African American Literature

requirementGroups.label: Upper-level literature (4)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Four Upper Level Courses. Four English courses at the 200 or 300 level: Two in British or American literature before 1800; Two in British or American literature after 1800
